title: Research: screen late block changes against the a=1/99 target
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Under the retained width-73 coverage law, centre charge and rank-51 halving cap, a uniform replacement word must escape at least eight of the selected word's twelve late block interfaces before the optimistic complex-side screen opens at `a=1/99`.

This package combines Ali Romman's PR1429 all-order block minima with Douglas Colkitt's PR1240 cost relaxation. The new step fixes each block's rank mass by telescoping its monotone endpoints, then grants every remaining unit of mass the cheapest allowed rank-51 child. Exact intervals put the cheapest five retained blocks above one and the dearest four below one. We check the full 48-cell retained-count table.

All twelve retained blocks give a conditional primitive-saving ceiling below `0.007340317424864`, even after this favorable treatment of the other work. A separate control shows that one extra rank-one call closes the dearest-four margin; deducting that call's mass from the old idle remainder would give an invalid favorable result.

This is a conditional target obstruction and screening result. No new decoder, attained exponent, production defect or selected-frontier change is claimed. Only `research/complex-block-target-screen/` is added.

## Task and overlap

- Task: `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 3; nonce `1ac531a5f578bb9e7df3e8c5db28424f`; refined scope `02b31ebd160542c86299/mandatory-late-blocks/target-1-99`.
- Claim: [Discussion #1723](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1723), posted as **jmbarrancoml**.

- The contribution adds the target-count consequence. PR1429 proves the block minima; PR1240 bounds packing of a fixed word. Here the other local paths may change, provided the retained blocks' boundary premises still hold.
- Final overlap refresh at 08:01–08:02 UTC covered 412 open PRs and 359 Discussion records with complete pagination. Exact-scope matches were this claim/package and the credited predecessor. Main remained at the stated base.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-block-target-screen
```

Registered replay passed on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.13. Optimized CPython 3.14.6 produced identical JSON. A separate integer 99th-root oracle agrees with the inherited logarithm/Taylor engine on all 48 decisions: 33 exclusions and 15 open relaxations. Eleven rejection and hypothesis-sensitivity controls pass. Source pins, package metadata, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks pass.

The complete predecessor replay also passed 36 source/block interfaces, 9,180 subset checks, 36 independence minors and 12 controls. The new hook consumes its pinned certificate and written theorem; it does not rerun that predecessor command.

## Limits and credit

Retained blocks must preserve their dirty-input independence, eight-array interface, input and late-output frames, monotone growth, final rank nine and coupled orientation contract. Changed exterior work must re-establish those boundary premises. The integer eight-interface consequence concerns a common local provider; heterogeneous schedules need a weighted bill. Passing the relaxation supplies no physical construction. Additional calls outside the coverage identity remain additive charges.

Full native admission, compiler/hosting, precision/tape, analytic transfer, bit-side improvement, Lean verification and independent human review remain outside this contribution. Hosted CI has not passed at submission.

GitHub reports `action_required` for the [registered package run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38532584929). Local validation passed; hosted verification remains outstanding.

Credit Ali Romman, Thomas DiFiore, Douglas Colkitt, the PR1012 coverage-law authors, Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe and the retained k8/T16 lineage. Prepared for **Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml)** with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, code and prose, plus read-only source exploration. Apache-2.0; frozen predecessor files and licenses remain intact.

## Open next questions

Specify new array/frame/output contracts for at least eight blocks, then price the complete replacement without unsupported idle credits. A concrete admitted replacement is the blocker. The README and TASK record this bounded handoff and the alternative of changing centre charge, coverage or the rank guard.
